# ADT

> > ADT provides professionally monitored home security systems, alarm monitoring, and smart home automation featuring ADT+, Outdoor Video, and Trusted Neighbor technology across the United States.

ADT is a leading home security provider offering comprehensive security packages including intrusion detection, video surveillance, and smart home integration through the ADT+ Mobile App. The company serves customers nationwide with local installation and 24/7 professional monitoring services.

## Key Topics

- ADT+ Mobile App
- Outdoor Video
- Trusted Neighbor
- Home Security Systems
- Video Monitoring
- Alarm Monitoring
- Intrusion Detection
- 4G LTE Upgrade
- 3G to 4G Conversion
- Security Packages
- Smart Home Touchscreen Panel
- Professional Installation
- 24/7 Monitoring
- Front Door Protection
- Total Safety
